name: experiences
title: hub.experiences
lead: The portals of the experience grounds. `experience` is what `/play` takes.
signature: hub.experiences() → { {slot: number, experience: string, title: string, pitch: string ?, icon: string ?, banner: string ?, players: number ?} }
returns: { {slot: number , experience: string , title: string , pitch: string ?, icon: string ?, banner: string ?, players: number ?} }

usedIn.quote: for _, e in hub.experiences() do print(e.slot, e.experience) end
- `hub.experiences()` returns a list of `{slot, experience, title, pitch, icon, banner, players}`. `experience` is the name `/play` takes. A slot that is not in the list has no experience.
